pre_spend_gates.evidence: v2 governance validator passes exact schema, card, contract, amendment, claim-boundary, and stage-plan hashes
immutable model and tokenizer revisions, chat template, license, and local artifact hashes
all six arm manifests bind identical scenario IDs where registered, exact final-answer joins, token counts, and arm hashes
F3_reflection versus F3_concrete_reflection total train-token spread is at most 0.02 and scenario counts are identical
cluster-disjoint train and validation assignments are immutable and hash-bound
zero exact, normalized, and registered n-gram overlap with every evaluation universe
evaluation content hashes and access policy are frozen before any adapter training output exists
every suite parses synthetic pass, fail, and malformed rows; identity_behavior dimensions have 100 percent expected parse outcomes
base endpoint, judge revisions, row joins, sign convention, and fitted representation probe are frozen under the reanchoring plan
full eight-GPU topology completes 50 steps, finite loss, checkpoint round trip, and ten valid generations
a signed authorization binds every preceding receipt and the exact pilot command without weakening caps

pilot.purpose: stack, data, checkpoint, evaluator, variance, and throughput validation only
pilot.topology: one full eight-GPU distributed model load at a time

schedule.allocation_rule: After the ten-step warmup, set a single steps_per_arm to min(50, floor((7200 - 1200 - measured_warmup_seconds) / (6 * measured_seconds_per_step))). Cancel unless this value is at least 10; use the same value and registered sample IDs for every arm.

promotion_gates: all six arms complete the identical allocated step count before the wall-clock cap
no NaN, infinity, OOM, scheduler eviction, resource-cap breach, or data/hash mismatch occurs
for every arm the final five-loss mean is no greater than 1.05 times its first five-loss mean
every arm saves and reloads one adapter checkpoint and produces ten syntactically valid generations
synthetic judge parse rate is 1.0 and sealed development parse rate is at least 0.95
for each registered scored development dimension no single score value contains more than 0.90 of parsed rows
the measured throughput forecast fits all six overnight arms at the registered minimum dose inside the overnight cap
pilot cleanup reports no surviving child process and no mounted or open run artifact

overnight.launch_only_if: every pre-spend gate and every pilot promotion gate passed
overnight.dose_rule: Reserve 7200 seconds for checkpointing, evaluation, and cleanup. Set one shared steps_per_arm to floor((43200 - 7200) / (6 * pilot_median_seconds_per_step)); cancel unless this reaches the protocol's registered minimum dose. Freeze the resulting integer in the overnight authorization receipt before launch.
mid_run_abort_rules: abort all arms immediately on any frozen input, split, curriculum, evaluator, or command hash mismatch
abort all arms immediately on any NaN or infinite loss or gradient
abort all arms if loss exceeds two times the arm's first valid ten-step median for three consecutive logged steps after warmup
abort all arms on a second OOM or any attempt to continue with an arm-specific batch, rank, precision, or sequence-length change
abort all arms if a required checkpoint is more than ten minutes late
abort all arms on an NVIDIA Xid or uncorrectable ECC event, GPU temperature at or above 90 C for two samples, or loss of any allocated GPU
abort all arms when run-directory bytes exceed the hard cap
on scheduler warning or ten minutes remaining, checkpoint once and exit without starting another arm
if any arm cannot resume from its last hash-valid checkpoint, stop the matched run rather than dropping that arm
completion_requires: all six arms reach the same frozen step count
all checkpoint and adapter artifact hashes are recorded
sealed evaluations are joined one-to-one without missing or duplicate rows
cleanup reports zero surviving child processes
a final resource receipt reports wall time, GPU hours, peak run-directory bytes, and abort-rule status

paper_packaging.selection_rule: report the highest fully passed empirical rung and every failed registered endpoint
paper_packaging.required_governance_label_while_review_p: Scholar review was pending when the exact hash-bound wording was fielded.
artifact_bundle: stage event logs and cleanup summaries
